$comment: #EXP-1642 (owner 2026-11-06): ISSUES AND CHATS IN THE PHONE'S OWN SEARCH ×2 (iOS CoreSpotlight `CSSearchableItem`s, Android AppSearch documents in the platform `AppSearchManager` / Jetpack `androidx.appsearch` with `setSchemaTypeVisibilityForSystemUi`; web and desktop have none). Model = pure `systemSearchItems` + `parseSystemSearchId` (src/system-search.ts; iOS ExpCore `SystemSearch.swift`, Android `domain/SystemSearch.kt`), every mirror replays the `*Cases`. WHAT IS INDEXED, from the synced store of EACH signed-in account: the issues it holds that are neither trashed nor archived, newest `updatedAt` first, capped at `maxIssues`; then its chats with the share-targets.json direct-share filter (no agent conversation, NO ENCRYPTED chat: a tree key or a sealed title never reaches the OS index), newest first, capped at `maxChats`. An issue item: id `issuePrefix` + issue id, title = the issue title, subtitle = `copy.issueSubtitle` filled with the identifier and the board name, keywords = the identifier and the board name. A chat item: id `chatPrefix` + session id, title = the chat's display title, subtitle `copy.chatSubtitle`, keywords none. Each item lives in the account's domain (`domainPrefix` + local account id) so a sign-out deletes that domain and nothing else; a client re-syncs the index at most once per `debounceMs` after its store changes, upserting the current items and deleting the ids that left. Descriptions, comments and messages are NEVER indexed. OPENING a result: the app routes the parsed id like a push tap, under the account of the item's domain: an issue opens THE issue page, a chat opens the session (inbox-route.json session target); an id that no longer resolves opens the normal start screen. No new component.

itemCases.name: live issues newest first then plain chats, capped, sealed and agent chats left out
an issue whose board is not held: the identifier alone
